newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish pension funds climb 3.3 pct in Q3 - survey.
newsitem.headline: Irish pension funds climb 3.3 pct in Q3 - survey.

text.p: Irish pension funds climbed steadily in the third quarter, with the average fund increasing by 3.3 percent over the third quarter to bring the average return for the year to date to 12.6 percent, a survey published on Monday said.
UK and Irish equities led the way, accompanied by Irish gilts, the survey by Mercer Actuaries and Benefit Consultants said.
It said the Irish bond index had posted a 5.8 percent return over the quarter, buoyed by the high volume of EMU-related purchases by overseas investors.

The average Irish pension fund held over 70 percent of its portfolio in equities, a practice that served well in a period where every major equity market save Japan returned in excess of 10 percent to the Irish investor, Mercer said.
It said that out of the 15 professional investment managers monitored in the survey, Friends Provident had performed best over the quarter with a return of 5.0 percent.
Friends Provident is also the leader for the year to date, with a return of 15.9 percent.
